citation.authors: Garcia-Coronado JM, Martinez-Olvera L, Elizondo-Omana RE, Acosta-Olivo CA et al

cited_by.title: Collagen for hair, nails and joints

record.population: Adults with osteoarthritis in randomised placebo-controlled trials of oral collagen
record.finding: Total WOMAC score and VAS pain score fell with collagen, and stiffness improved. The WOMAC pain and function sub-scores did not differ significantly from placebo.
record.note: Number of participants and ethnicity not in the abstract. The mixed sub-scores are why this card stays thin.
